_comment: Widget visual contracts, enforced by scripts/verify-widget-contracts.sh (Layer 5). A contract lists the properties a widget's CSS MUST declare for the widget to be visible and usable at all. Missing property = fail; wrong value is Layer 3's business.
_provenance: Rebuilt for wasayel-platform on 2026-08-11 from the acommerce-lab/acommerce-platform original. Every selector below was checked to exist in the stylesheets App.razor actually links BEFORE being written here: 33 of the origin's 36 contracts had real subjects in this repo. Three were dropped as subjectless — .act-bubble, .act-navbar and .act-footer use the `act-` (commerce-templates) prefix, which does not exist here; our prefixes are ac- / acm- / acs-. Seven contracts were added for our own widgets that the origin had none for.
_min_values_are_not_enforced: The `min-values` entries below are recorded INTENT, not gates. The origin script's header claimed it verified them; its code only ever checked `required`, so no min-value has ever been enforced in either repo. They are kept as documentation of the intended floor and as ready input if a future pass adds numeric checking — but nothing here should be read as 'this minimum is guaranteed'.

.ac-input.description: Text input must be visible, clickable, readable

.ac-textarea.description: Multi-line input — as ac-input plus min-height

.ac-btn.description: Button must be fingertip-sized, bold, distinguishable

.ac-card.description: Card must visually contain its children with border + radius

.ac-card-body.description: Card body must have internal padding

.ac-field.description: Form field wrapper spaces fields vertically

.ac-label.description: Label must be visible above its input with spacing

.ac-alert.description: Alert must stand out from the page with background + padding

.acs-bubble.description: Chat bubble (AcChatBubble / chat pages): padding on all sides plus radius. Background comes from the -mine / -other variants, so it is not required here.

.s-card.description: Generic card (AcStatsGrid, settings panels, dashboard tiles). Needs background + border so the card shape is visible.

.ac-search.description: Search box: input inside a bordered, padded shell tappable anywhere.

.ac-tile.description: Category tile wrapper — icon circle + label. The wrapper is transparent; .ac-tile-icon carries the fill. Only the tap target matters here.

.ac-tile-icon.description: Category tile icon circle — pill filled with a tinted brand colour.

.ac-space.description: Listing / space preview card. Must contain image + body with border and radius.

.ac-space-body.description: Space card body — padding so text does not touch the image edge.

.ac-hero.description: Hero banner — solid brand background, rounded corners, internal padding.

.ac-cta.description: CTA card — icon + title + subtitle on a bold background.

.ac-chip.description: Filter chip — pill button with a toggleable active state.

.ac-sort-select.description: Sort dropdown — native select styled to match inputs.

.ac-viewtoggle-btn.description: View-toggle button — the parent .ac-viewtoggle carries the frame, so the button itself is transparent until active; only the tap target is contracted.

.ac-sheet.description: Bottom sheet — slides from the viewport bottom; needs surface + rounded top corners.

.ac-modal.description: Modal dialog — centred surface with a visible frame.

.ac-topnav.description: Desktop top navigation — bordered strip above the page.

.ac-stickybar.description: Sticky action bar — visible surface so it does not float invisibly.

.ac-map-sim.description: Simulated map — bordered surface the size of the content area.

.ac-searchitem.description: Search suggestion row — padded tappable row.

.ac-badge.description: ADDED for wasayel (AcBadge.razor). Status pill — must read as a pill: padding, radius, and a weight that separates it from body text.

.ac-empty.description: ADDED for wasayel (AcEmpty.razor). Empty state — the screen a user sees when there is no data; needs a surface and generous padding or it reads as a broken page.

.ac-listrow.description: ADDED for wasayel (AcListRow.razor). Tappable list row — needs a surface and internal padding so rows are separable.

.ac-spinner.description: ADDED for wasayel (AcSpinner.razor). Loading spinner — drawn entirely from a partially-coloured border, so the border and the round shape ARE the widget.

.ac-viewtoggle.description: ADDED for wasayel (AcViewToggle.razor). The group frame that .ac-viewtoggle-btn sits inside — this is where the visible border lives.

.acs-seg.description: ADDED for wasayel (AcSegmentControl.razor). Segmented control track — a bordered, padded rail holding the segments.

.ac-avatar.description: ADDED for wasayel (AcAvatar.razor). Avatar — round, centred, and clipped. `background` is deliberately NOT required: AcAvatar.razor sets a per-user gradient inline (line 14), so demanding it in CSS would be a false alarm.
